addons.name: ForeverAddonSkins
addons.title: Forever Addon Skins
addons.notes: Bridge: gives my own addons (ForeverLibraryBooks, ...) the EllesmereUI window treatment, so they match the skinned Forever windows.

addons.name: ForeverSatchel
addons.title: Forever Satchel
addons.notes: Two bars: best food/drink (+ Well Fed food and your regen racial) and a cheapest-first delete queue with free bag space.

addons.name: TwitchEmotes_EllesmereUI
addons.title: Twitch Emotes - EllesmereUI Bridge
addons.notes: Animates TwitchEmotes inside EllesmereUI Chat windows. Edits neither addon.

addons.name: MapEnhance
addons.title: MapEnhance
addons.notes: Transport markers (boats, zeppelins, portals, trams), flight master markers, city markers, dungeon/raid entrance markers and profession specialization trainer markers on the world map, your own custom markers (Ctrl+Shift+click), Ctrl+click editing and Ctrl+drag moving of markers and the waypoint, zone level ranges on the hover label, and a fuzzy search box on the map that highlights and zooms to raids, boats, specialization trainers and more.

addons.name: ForeverLibraryBooks
addons.title: Forever Library Books & Secret Questlines
addons.notes: WoW Forever secrets: every Library Book plus secret questline guides (Cozy Sleeping Bag...) with routing, distance and progress tracking.

addons.name: ForeverProfessions
addons.title: Forever Professions
addons.notes: Interactive wow-professions.com leveling guides: bag-aware shopping list, vendor auto-buy, auction search, waypoints.

addons.name: ClickedForever
addons.title: Clicked Forever
addons.notes: Easy keybind and macro management. Fork of Clicked with better drag and drop and an "Always use highest rank" checkbox.

addons.name: PoI_Finder
addons.title: PoI Finder
addons.notes: Fuzzy-find trainers, vendors, flight masters and other points of interest, then set a waypoint with one click.

addons.name: ForeverHunter
addons.title: ForeverHunter
addons.notes: Hunter alerts: one alert line (pet, ammo, range, aspect, Auto Shot), a prep row before the pull, an ammo counter. /fh for options.

addons.name: ForeverIcons
addons.title: Forever Icons
addons.notes: Shows the icon name on spell and item tooltips; minimap button opens a fuzzy search that copies an icon's name, texture path or Wowhead link. /fi

addons.name: QuestHeaderCleaner
addons.title: Quest Header Cleaner
addons.notes: Shows quest count per quest log zone header and adds buttons to track or abandon every quest under it.

addons.name: ThreatProbe
addons.title: ThreatProbe
addons.notes: Shows your threat on every nameplate as an icon, a bar or a number. /tp for options.

addons.name: PetTrainerKnown
addons.title: Pet Trainer Known
addons.notes: Marks abilities your current pet already knows in the Beast Training window.

addons.name: ItemTree_EllesmereUIBags
addons.title: ItemTree - EllesmereUI Bags
addons.notes: Shows ItemTree's New/Changed badges and Keep marks on EllesmereUI Bags slots. Edits neither addon.

addons.name: LFGForeverWhere
addons.title: LFG Forever - Where You At
addons.notes: Shows each group leader's zone in the LFG Forever window (companion addon).

addons.name: CheapestDelete
addons.title: Cheapest Delete
addons.notes: Button in the EllesmereUI Bags header that deletes the lowest-value item stack.

addons.name: EllesmereCDMRange
addons.title: Ellesmere CDM Range
addons.notes: Out-of-range (red) / out-of-mana (blue) tint for Cooldown Manager icons.
